subject: Final week push — proposed conversion sweetener for Innovatix
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Final week push — proposed conversion sweetener for Innovatix

Team,

Quick background — Innovatix’s 30-day trial ends next Friday (4/2). The pilot metrics look strong: 2.3x throughput gains on our hosted LLM routes and embeddings consumption is trending at ~1.6M tokens/week. They raised an internal question on predictable spend and wanted a better on-ramp to a reserved commit.

They’re signaling intent to convert this week if we can give them an onboarding credit or a short extension. They asked first for a $12k credit; I think we can be more surgical. My ask: approve either a $8k invoice credit applied to month 1 OR a 2-week trial extension + $5k credit. Both options would be conditioned on signing the standard SOW and a 12-month committed tier.

Attached: MAP (customer-facing timeline) and our suggested contract redlines.

Can I get quick thumbs from pricing (Aditya) and enablement (Marissa) — ideally by EOD today so I can reply to their procurement thread and close before quarter end?

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
[Attachment: MAP_Innovatix_v2.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final week push — proposed conversion sweetener for Innovatix

Karthik —

Thanks for the summary. From an enablement/onboarding cadence perspective, a 2-week extension materially reduces churn risk and buys the CSM time to complete the integration checklist (SSO, dataplane onboarding, billing handoff). If procurement wants a dollar number, $8k feels like the ceiling for a $50k ARR initial commit; $5k + extension seems like a better playbook for long-term retention.

Two asks: 1) can you tie the credit to a signed commitment (standard), and 2) ensure the MAP has concrete success milestones so we can measure adoption during the extension. I looked at the MAP and added a couple of milestone gates — see comments.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_Innovatix_v2.pdf (annotated)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-29T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final week push — proposed conversion sweetener for Innovatix

+1 to Marissa. Operationally, we should avoid a precedent of large open-ended credits. Recommend we approve up to $8,000 as a one-time invoice credit with these constraints:
- Credit applied to first invoice only
- Customer signs 12-month committed tier (min $50k ARR)
- No retroactive usage refunds; credit does not cover excess over committed throughput

If the customer prefers runway, we can offer 14-day extension + $4k credit. For Innovatix specifically, they’re evaluating Dedicated in the mid-term; potential upside justifies the smaller concession.

-Vanessa
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-29T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Final week push — proposed conversion sweetener for Innovatix

Aditya — forwarding the thread + MAP and redlines. Customer reply (below) says they will sign by EOD if we can confirm an $8k credit applied to month 1. Can pricing sign off on that amount? If yes, I’ll route DocuSign and push procurement.

Numbers for quick context: anticipated first-year commit = $60k ARR; expected start month volume ~1.5M tokens/month; typical gross margin assumptions align with our incentive guardrails.

Please reply with explicit approval phrased like: "Aditya — approved: $8,000 invoice credit to be applied to first invoice for Innovatix, contingent on signed 12-month commitment. Finance to issue credit note."

Thanks —
Karthik

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@innovatix.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@innovatix.com
Cc: David Chen <david.chen@innovatix.com>
Date: 2026-03-30T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final week push — proposed conversion sweetener for Innovatix

Karthik —

Appreciate the quick follow. We’re ready to move to a committed plan and start onboarding next week, but procurement flagged the need for a small offset to help with internal approvals. If Redwood can provide an $8,000 credit applied to the first invoice OR a 14-day trial extension while we sign the contract, we’ll execute the SOW and get the DocuSign returned by EOD Friday.

Prefer the credit route to simplify our finance cadence. If you can confirm by noon PDT today, I’ll get internal approval and share the signed SOW.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Director of Product, Innovatix
samantha@innovatix.com
[Attachment: Innovatix_PO_request.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-31T18:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final week push — proposed conversion sweetener for Innovatix

Karthik — approved.

Aditya — approved: $8,000 invoice credit to be applied to Innovatix first invoice, contingent on signed 12-month commitment. Finance (Neha) to issue credit note and coordinate billing. Legal/Commercial will route the finalized SOW via DocuSign (link below).

Notes: please ensure the credit is set as a one-time balance adjustment (no ongoing discount) and captured on the invoice line so accounting can reconcile next month. Neha — can you confirm once the credit is posted? Marissa — CS to kick off onboarding the day the contract is signed.

DocuSign (final): https://www.docusign.net/contract/INN-3421-final

-Aditya Rao
Head of Pricing & Commercials, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: contract_redline_innovatix.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
